shots.note: POWER OPEN: the object before the person
yank back to reveal the whole table
HOOK: face lands as the list completes
a hand covers it - thesis in one gesture
every person on Earth, floating numbers
it cannot be hidden, edited, or faked
not salary, not debt — what you have now
car, house, job, clothes, watch, phone, street
money is the one thing that stayed hidden
one flat tire from a bad month
the coat, Saturday, the number falls
they look around to see who noticed
the question has an answer now
no eye contact above a head
you look at a number the way you look at a scar
I'm fine. I'm busy. It's on me.
a friend can't afford the trip
everyone lets them say they're busy
the sentence is visible as a lie
fine is a claim that can be checked
so the question stops being asked
asking it means asking about the number
an office where nobody asks, and everyone can see
not the same as knowing each other
the wedding, after the costs. declining is a statement
the room goes on without that seat
they go, and the number drops
honesty was the only option left
you don't choose who you love by a number
the split stops being generous, and feels like being weighed
the room sorts itself into clusters
family. you can see your parents' number
falling, and they can see yours
had late, and badly, and mostly unsaid
with the number public, that conversation is never had
nobody has to be the one to bring it up
what it removes is the moment of telling
your father chooses to be honest
the number gives the data and takes the conversation
you would rather have had the conversation

acts.title: ACT FOUR MARKET TURNS INSIDE OUT

shots.note: money moves. credit has to guess
promoted, inherit, business. the number says no
prices stop being fixed. the same coffee
the same flight. large pays more, small pays less
the second market. desperation is public
the number is a targeting system
the most exposed person in the crowd
the employer wants your salary visible
the bank wants your spending visible
the platform wants your preferences visible

acts.title: ACT SIX WE DID THIS ALREADY

shots.note: what he shows / what is left
focus leaves the feed, finds the statement
the leased car and the borrowed watch
a high number says yes — an advertisement
a bad year, without the announcement
a hand rests on the folder
allowed to be unremarkable in public
